limits: Only32 outcome-unfiltered eligible old Act4 campfire roots. No trained policy or natural-population win rate. Native trace and frozen-parent checks reuse the admitted collector verifier; no claim of an independent simulator implementation.
decision: Do not prioritize or expand this campfire-only pilot. Only one of32 measured families has a better alternative; nineteen lose under both choices. Do not turn this hindsight limit into a population bound or train a large model to memorize one successful exception.
